title: Data Schemas
markdown:
The shapes below are the load-bearing data structures: episodic SQLite tables (in `episodic_memory.db`) and the Pydantic models for departments and people.

### Episodic tables

| Table | Key columns |
|---|---|
| `decisions` | `id`, `timestamp`, `domain`, `summary`, `rationale`, `outcome`, `tags`, `department`, `session_id` |
| `initiatives` | `id`, `title`, `status`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `summary`, `department` |
| `advice_given` | `id`, `timestamp`, `domain`, `query_summary`, `advice_summary`, `department`, `session_id` |
| `scheduled_actions` | `id`, `created_at`, `run_at`, `channel`, `channel_ref`, `intent_text`, `status`, `attempts`, `kind`, `department`, `assigned_to_person_id`, `awaiting_response_since`, `scope_key`, `required_scope` |
| `outbound_context` | `id`, `created_at`, `channel`, `channel_ref`, `recipient_person_id`, `outbound_text`, `originating_session_id`, `outbound_message_id`, `consumed_at`, `status` |

| `dynamic_workflows` | `name` (PK), `definition` (JSON of `DynamicWorkflowDef`), `is_active`, `created_at`, `updated_at` |

`department` and `session_id` are additive columns (default `''`); `session_id` scopes per-thread recall. `scheduled_actions.status` ∈ pending / running / done / failed / cancelled, and `scheduled_actions.kind` includes `dynamic_workflow` (a cadence-fired user-created workflow run). `dynamic_workflows` stores user-created (dynamic) workflow definitions interpreted by the generic `DynamicWorkflow` engine; the JSON `definition` holds free-text input fields and an ordered step list (specialist / approval_gate / synthesis) plus an optional cadence.

### Talent tables

| Table | Key columns |
|---|---|
| `engagements` | `id`, `role_title`, `department` (free text, not a FK), `status`, `location`, `comp_band`, `must_haves`, `description`, `archived` |
| `candidates` | `id`, `engagement_id` (FK), `full_name`, `current_title`, `current_company`, `email`, `linkedin_url`, `source`, `stage`, `fit_score`, `screening_summary`, `notes`, `archived` |
| `offers` | `id`, `candidate_id` (FK), `engagement_id` (FK), `status`, `comp_summary`, `package_md`, `note`, `expires_at`, `extended_at`, `decided_at`, `approval_run_id`, `approved_by_person_id`, `nudge_action_ids_json`, `archived` |

`candidates.stage` ∈ lead / screened / interviewed / offer / placed / rejected. `offers.status` ∈ draft / pending_approval / extended / accepted / declined / expired / rescinded, enforced by a transition map in `talent.store.set_offer_status` (terminals immutable); at most one open offer per candidate. `expires_at` is set at extend time, and expiry never auto-flips the status — only `record_offer_decision` does. See the [Talent](#talent) section.

`outbound_context` links an outbound DM OE sent back to the conversation that triggered it, so the recipient's reply can be hydrated with that backstory instead of starting from an empty per-person session. `status` ∈ open / consumed; the row is one-shot consumed on the first matched reply within a 72h window. See Integrations → Cross-session DM context.

### Department / Goal / ChecklistItem

| Model | Fields |
|---|---|
| `DepartmentConfig` | `slug`, `title`, `specialist_key`, `charter`, `authority_level`, `head_person_id`, `head_persona_slug`, `cadences`, `slack_channel_id`, `discord_channel_id`, `telegram_chat_id` |
| `Goal` | `id`, `department_slug`, `period_type`, `period_value`, `key_result`, `target`, `current`, `status`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `last_reviewed_at` |
| `DepartmentState` | `config`, `goals`, `headcount`, `budget_usd`, `member_person_ids`, `updated_at` |

`authority_level` ∈ `auto_execute` / `propose_only` / `escalate`; `Goal.status` ∈ `on_track` / `at_risk` / `off_track`.

### Person

| Field group | Fields |
|---|---|
| Identity | `id`, `full_name`, `role`, `is_principal`, `department_slugs` |
| Contact | `email`, `slack_user_id`, `telegram_chat_id`, `discord_user_id`, `preferred_channel` |
| Routing | `availability`, `authority_scope`, `response_sla_hours`, `on_leave_until`, `reports_to_person_id` |
| Lifecycle | `archived`, `created_at`, `updated_at` |

Exactly one `Person` should have `is_principal=True` — the fallback approver when no delegated person matches.
